crossRefs.note: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.
The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
“I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
He who hates me, hates my Father also.
Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

translations.web: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
translations.bsb: An unjust man is detestable to the righteous, and one whose way is upright is detestable to the wicked.
translations.kjv: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
translations.asv: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous; And he that is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.
